name: Customer Order Schema - ER
code:
---
config:
  theme: forest
---
erDiagram
    direction LR
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ADDRESS : has
    ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_ITEM : contains
    ORDER ||--|| PAYMENT : "paid by"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_ITEM : "appears in"
    CATEGORY ||--o{ PRODUCT : groups

    CUSTOMER {
        string id PK
        string full_name
        string email UK
        datetime created_at
    }

    ADDRESS {
        string id PK
        string customer_id FK
        string line_1
        string city
        string region
        string postal_code
    }

    ORDER {
        string id PK
        string customer_id FK
        datetime created_at
        string status
        decimal total_amount
    }

    ORDER_ITEM {
        string id PK
        string order_id FK
        string product_id FK
        int quantity
        decimal unit_price
    }

    PRODUCT {
        string id PK
        string category_id FK
        string name
        decimal price
        int stock
    }

    CATEGORY {
        string id PK
        string name
        string slug UK
    }

    PAYMENT {
        string id PK
        string order_id FK
        decimal amount
        string method
        string status
    }
